name: diagnostic-telephone
notes: Diagnostic only: deliberately remove bass and treble to test whether KA17 EQ affects playback. Not a listening recommendation. Cuts only, with -12 dB preamp. Eight zero-gain bands clear leftover filters because this KA17 retained a count of ten when asked for two. Keep playback volume low and do not turn it up to compensate; restoring custom-2 will be much louder if EQ is active. Hardware readback does not establish that the independent EQ enable state is on. Both custom presets remain unchanged.
